```{r}
library(fpp3)

?aus_production
?pelt
?gafa_stock
?vic_elec
```

```{r}
aus_production|>
  select(Quarter, Bricks)|>
  autoplot(Bricks)
```

```{r}
pelt|> autoplot(Lynx)
```

```{r}
gafa_stock |>autoplot(Close)
```

```{r}
vic_elec |> autoplot(Demand)
```

```{r}
vic_elec |>
  filter(
    Time >= ymd_hms("2014-01-01 00:00:00"),
    Time < ymd_hms("2014-01-08 00:00:00")
  ) |>
  autoplot(Demand) +
  scale_x_datetime(
    date_breaks = "1 day",
    date_labels = "%d %b"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Electricity demand in Victoria",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Electricity demand (MW)"
  )
```

```{r}
gafa_stock |>
  group_by(Symbol) |>
  filter(Close == max(Close)) |>
  select(Symbol, Date, Close)
```

```{r}
tute1 <- readr::read_csv("data/tute1.csv")
View(tute1)
```

```{r}
mytimeseries <- tute1 |>
  mutate(Quarter = yearquarter(Quarter)) |>
  as_tsibble(index = Quarter)
```

```{r}
mytimeseries |>
  pivot_longer(-Quarter) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Quarter, y = value, colour = name)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(name ~ ., scales = "free_y")
```

```{r}
install.packages("USgas")
library(USgas)
library(fpp3)
```

```{r}
head(us_total)
```

```{r}
us_total_ts <- us_total |>
  as_tsibble(
    index = year,
    key = state
  )
```

```{r}
us_total_ts |>
  filter(state %in% c(
    "Maine",
    "Vermont",
    "New Hampshire",
    "Massachusetts",
    "Connecticut",
    "Rhole Island"
  )
  )|>
  autoplot(y)
```

```{r}
readxl::read_excel("data/tourism.xlsx")
```

```{r}
tourism <- tourism |>
  mutate(Quarter = yearquarter(Quarter)) |>
  as_tsibble(index = Quarter)
```

```{r}
tourism |> group_by(Region, Purpose)|>
  summarize(
    Average_Trips = mean(Trips)
  )|>
  arrange(desc(Average_Trips))
```

```{r}
tourism_state <- tourism |>
  as.tibble() |>
  group_by(State, Quarter)|>
  summarise(
    Trip = sum(Trips),
    .groups="drop"
  )|>
  as_tsibble(index = Quarter,
             key = State)
```

```{r}
set.seed(35323876)
myseries <- aus_retail |>
  filter(`Series ID` == sample(aus_retail$`Series ID`,1))
```

```{r}
retail |> autoplot(Turnover)
retail |> gg_season(Turnover)
retail |> gg_lag(Turnover)
retail |> gg_subseries(Turnover)
```

```{r}
retail |>
  ACF(Turnover) |> 
  autoplot()
```

```{r}
aus_pigs_victoria <- aus_livestock |> mutate(
  Month = yearmonth(Month)
)|>
  filter(
    Month >= yearmonth("1990 Jan"),
    Month <= yearmonth("2020 Dec"),
    Animal == "Pigs",
    State  == "Victoria"
  )
```

```{r}
aus_pigs_victoria |> autoplot(Count)
```

```{r}
aus_pigs_victoria |> ACF(Count,lag_max = 300) |>
  autoplot()
```

```{r}
dgoog <- gafa_stock |>
  filter(Symbol == "GOOG", year(Date) >= 2018) |>
  mutate(trading_day = row_number()) |>
  update_tsibble(index = trading_day, regular = TRUE) |>
  mutate(diff = difference(Close))
```

```{r}
dgoog |> ACF(Close, lag_max = 20)|>
  autoplot()
```
